sections.markdown: Calls are retried with backoff when a retry is safe: a modelled throttling error is retried for any operation; transport failures, HTTP 500, 502, 503 and 504 and other retryable modelled errors only for operations that are read-only, idempotent or carry an idempotency token. For operations that declare an idempotency token, an unset token is generated once per call and reused on every attempt; set it yourself to replay one logical request across calls. `runtime::Config::retry(runtime::Retry { .. })` changes the attempt limit (3, the first included) and backoff; `runtime::Retry::none()` turns retries off.

For operations that declare an idempotency token, an unset token is generated once per call and reused on every attempt; set it yourself to replay one logical request across calls. Set `retry: { maxAttempts }` in the client configuration to change the attempt limit (3, the first included), or `retry: false` to turn retries off.
